create.name: Charlotte Rotterdam & Pieter Oosthuizen
create.bio:
Charlotte Rotterdam and Pieter Oosthuizen are a married pair of Vajrayana Buddhist teachers who work together under the name Skymind. Both are senior teachers in Lama Tsultrim Allione's lineage at Tara Mandala in Colorado, and both have trained with Tibetan masters including Namkhai Norbu Rinpoche and Lama Tharchin Rinpoche. Charlotte, who grew up in New York and studied theology at Harvard Divinity School, also teaches at Naropa University, where she leads its centre for contemplative education. Pieter trained as a lawyer in South Africa before moving to Colorado, where he held leadership posts at Naropa and at Tara Mandala.

Their teaching centres on Machig Labdrön, the eleventh-century Tibetan yogini behind the Chöd lineage, and on her short, direct instructions for recognising the open, aware nature of mind. Students move from steadying attention towards simply resting in awareness, while also turning gently towards fear and difficulty rather than away from it, often through the five-step Feeding Your Demons process. Charlotte and Pieter run a nine-month online Skymind programme, weekend and week-long retreats in the United States and Europe, and one-to-one and couples mentoring. Their book, Skymind: The Radical Path of Open Awareness, was published by Shambhala.

books.title: Skymind: The Radical Path of Open Awareness
books.author: Charlotte Rotterdam, Pieter Oosthuizen
books.description: A guide to the nature-of-mind teachings of the Tibetan yogini Machig Labdrön, built around short verses attributed to her, each followed by a modern commentary. It follows the traditional arc of ground, path and fruition, from settling attention to resting in open awareness and meeting hard experience with compassion.

courses.title: Skymind Resting in the Natural State
courses.description: A five-day meditation intensive at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York, drawing on the Mahamudra tradition and Machig Labdrön's instruction to rest in the natural state. Days combine talks, guided sitting, reflection, group conversation and time outdoors, with one evening given to a fireside Chöd demonstration. Open to beginners and experienced meditators.

courses.title: Skymind Yearlong: A Transformational Immersion Program
courses.description: A nine-month online programme running from the spring equinox to the winter solstice, organised with Tara Mandala. It weaves study of Machig Labdrön's texts with regular open-awareness meditation and practical work on bringing the teachings into daily life, with guest teachers and recorded sessions.

courses.title: Green Tara: Active Compassion for our Times (Online)
courses.description: A weekend online retreat with Charlotte Rotterdam on the Green Tara practice from a revealed text of Adzom Drukpa. It includes the oral transmission, a full explanation of the practice and time to reflect on bringing compassion into ordinary life. No prior Buddhist background is needed.

courses.title: Personal and Couples Mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one or couples sessions with Charlotte, Pieter or both, using the Feeding Your Demons process within a Buddhist frame. Sessions look at a particular obstacle or recurring pattern and work with it through visualisation and dialogue.
